rows.transcript_1: When you take care of yourself, you take care of your children. We all need to connect. Try to talk to friends, family, and other support networks every day. If it has been a while since you reached out to someone, do it now!
rows.transcript_2:
Bila anda menjaga diri sendiri, anda juga sedang menjaga anak‑anak anda. Kita semua perlukan hubungan dengan orang lain. Cuba berhubung dengan rakan, keluarga, atau sesiapa yang menyokong anda setiap hari.

Kalau sudah lama anda tidak menghubungi seseorang, cuba hubungi mereka sekarang! Siapa yang anda nak hubungi sekarang?

text_1_facilitator.eng: 😃😣😔This skill is about talking with your child about their feelings.

text_2.eng:
How does this help your child grow?
⭐ Talking about feelings with your child will help them learn how to express themselves. 
👌They will learn that all feelings are okay - even the negative ones.
 
Do you wonder how we can do so?
🌷 You can listen to them, think about how it must feel for them, and accept their emotions. 
🤗 This will help them recognise other people’s feelings, too.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 5️⃣ Here are 5 tips for how you can help your child learn how to cope with their emotions: LEARN, NOTICE, OPEN, TALK, and CARE.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 5️⃣ Here are 5 tips for how you can help your child learn how to cope with their emotions: LEARN, NOTICE, OPEN, TALK, and CARE.

section_1_text.eng:
💡 Learn about different emotions. 
😃 The 6 basic emotions are: Happy, Sad, Angry, Disgusted, Surprised, and Afraid.
👀 You can use facial expressions and physical movements to help your child learn different emotions. Make it a game!
🎨 As children grow, they learn to identify more emotions, like excitement, frustration, pride, loneliness, calm, guilt and confusion.

section_2_text.eng:
👀 Notice all emotions in your child. 
😃 You can also share positive emotions such as a sense of peace, happiness, or calmness.
💙 This allows them to appreciate the beautiful moments!

section_3_text.eng:
Notice 👀 and listen 👂 to your child when they share how they are feeling. 
💛 Accept how they feel.
🧸 Give them comfort.

section_4_text.eng:
😒 It is normal to have difficulty talking about and expressing emotions and feelings. 
👋 Remember, it is also normal to experience feelings in different ways.
💡 Learn to identify your own emotions, to experience them in our body, and to communicate about them

section_5_text.eng:
🌷 Use your actions or words to support your child and make them feel accepted and loved. You can hug or praise them!
💚 Remind your child that you are there for them and that they can always talk to you.

quiz_1_question.eng:
Home activity! ⭐ Talk about feelings with your child during one-on-one time today. Use words or expressions to describe both your own feelings and your child’s feelings - like “I am happy to see you, your child,” or “You look sad that playtime is over, your child.” Try this at least 3 times - make it fun!

Can you do it today?

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng: That’s okay. Try to make time this week.
